audit.model_allocation: Same model, call count, evidence schedule and output-token ceilings. Actual tokens differ.
audit.usage_counting: Sum top-level usage messages only; nested iterations repeat counts and are not added. Total input includes uncached input, cache creation, and cache reads.

conclusion: All three real model conditions completed. This fixed historical cohort has no later-recorded positive associations: AP and AUROC are undefined; P@5 is zero for every condition and the historical popularity baseline. No forecasting superiority can be inferred.
limitations: No positive labels in this frozen query: zero precision does not experimentally disprove the candidates, and undefined AP/AUROC cannot rank the methods.
Labels mean later CIViC release inclusion, not first publication, first scientific discovery or treatment benefit.
Modern model pretraining may include post-cutoff knowledge; a historical retrieval cutoff cannot establish historical ignorance.
Citation checks establish source identity and availability, not entailment or scientific truth; model hypotheses remain unverified.
One historical query and one model trajectory per condition cannot establish general representation superiority.
Retrieval and branch scheduler were fixed; this experiment does not evaluate exploration-policy advantage.
Actual input/output token totals differ, and the historical popularity comparator uses no model calls.
The original 20-candidate cohort is preserved; results are not directly comparable to the separate 683-candidate structural forecast report.

metadata.baseline_scope: same candidate set and source evidence; no model, token budget or representation equivalence claimed
metadata.score_definition: number of distinct target neighbors in historical claims supported by the same final 12 evidence rows

protocol.auroc: positive-negative pair concordance; ties receive half credit; null without both classes
protocol.average_precision: score-threshold grouped, non-interpolated; null without positives
protocol.comparison: identical complete candidate and outcome rows for every model

context.candidate_selection: one query: descending historical source claim degree, then query ID; candidates: descending historical target claim degree, then candidate ID
context.comparison_scope: representation and self-generated memory; retrieval and branch scheduler held fixed
context.labels: no outcomes accepted or loaded; final forecasts must be saved before separate evaluation
limitations: Modern model pretraining may include post-cutoff knowledge; retrieval cutoff cannot prove historical ignorance.
Citation validation checks identity and availability, not entailment or scientific truth.
Single small historical query is a functional experiment, not evidence of general forecasting superiority.
No-positive cohorts and non-comparable failed conditions must be reported explicitly.
Tools disabled and fresh empty working directories apply to the built-in live provider; injected providers are caller controlled.
context.matched_allocation: same candidates, evidence schedule, model, call and output-token ceilings; actual input/output tokens can differ
context.retrieval_selection: descending count of historical claims touching chosen endpoints, then availability date and evidence ID

protocol.macro: equal query weights, excluding undefined values with eligibility counts
protocol.outcome_meaning: recorded by the horizon; unobserved does not mean disproved
protocol.precision_at_k: hits / min(k, eligible candidates); denominator reported per query

source_manifest.association_semantics: An association may describe sensitivity, resistance, or conflicting findings; inspect contexts.

candidate_policy.candidate_rule: cartesian product of retained historical variants and therapy groups, excluding all historical predictive associations
candidate_policy.eligibility: accepted, unflagged Predictive evidence with variant, gene and therapy identifiers
candidate_policy.therapy_identity: whole group split only on commas outside parentheses, whitespace/case normalized, sorted; no synonym expansion
candidate_policy.therapy_order: descending historical evidence-row count within chosen variants, then stable ID
candidate_policy.variant_order: descending distinct historical therapy-group degree, then stable ID

source_manifest.claim_namespace: CIViC imported association IDs; not litmap normalized Claim atom IDs
source_manifest.date_semantics: release availability, not first publication or worldwide discovery
source_manifest.unknown_interaction: 2018 therapy groups lack interaction type; no combination or efficacy inference.
